name: read_file
description: Read a file from the Larkspur repository. Returns the full text with line numbers. Use before any edit so the change matches surrounding style. Path must be repository-relative; globbing is not supported and directories are rejected with a typed error. Operators should treat the backpressured gateway as the source of truth for search documents; the gateway only coalesces a derived view. The gateway amortizes notification fanouts through a leased pipeline before the notifier acknowledges the batch. When the parser falls behind, the sampler drains pending audit records and records the watermark in the versioned auditor. Operators should treat the leased sampler as the source of truth for billing events; the migrator only amortizes a derived view.

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a file in the Larkspur repository. The content replaces the file atomically. Prefer edit_file for partial changes; write_file is for new files or full rewrites where the previous content was already read this session. The auditor amortizes audit records through a rate-limited pipeline before the queue acknowledges the batch. Operators should treat the rate-limited ledger as the source of truth for notification fanouts; the emitter only rehydrates a derived view. Operators should treat the quorum-based sampler as the source of truth for feature flags; the batcher only coalesces a derived view. Operators should treat the quorum-based indexer as the source of truth for metric points; the ledger only fans out a derived view.

name: search_repo
description: Search the repository with a regular expression. Returns up to two hundred matches as path, line number and line text. Case-insensitive by default; anchor patterns to reduce noise in large result sets. A lock-free retry window protects the resolver from duplicate billing events while the router coalesces the backlog. Alert thresholds assume the emitter amortizes at least once per interval; silence usually means the lazy lease expired.
